events.verdict: Strawther (DEN) deflects the pass away from Agbaji (TOR) before it is stolen by Jokic (DEN).
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in Agbaji's (TOR) path and the contact during his layup attempt is incidental.
Dick (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position during Strawther's (DEN) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Braun (DEN) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from Dick (TOR).
